title: Python Language Server Configuration
description: This server can be configured using the `workspace/didChangeConfiguration` method. Each configuration option is described below. Note, a value of `null` means that we do not set a value and thus use the plugin's default value.

rols.configurationSources.description: List of configuration sources to use.

rols.plugins.autopep8.enabled.description: Enable or disable the plugin (disabling required to use `yapf`).

rols.plugins.flake8.config.description: Path to the config file that will be the authoritative config source.

rols.plugins.flake8.exclude.description: List of files or directories to exclude.

rols.plugins.flake8.extendIgnore.description: List of errors and warnings to append to ignore list.

rols.plugins.flake8.extendSelect.description: List of errors and warnings to append to select list.

rols.plugins.flake8.filename.description: Only check for filenames matching the patterns in this list.

rols.plugins.flake8.hangClosing.description: Hang closing bracket instead of matching indentation of opening bracket's line.

rols.plugins.flake8.ignore.description: List of errors and warnings to ignore (or skip).

rols.plugins.flake8.maxLineLength.description: Maximum allowed line length for the entirety of this run.

rols.plugins.flake8.perFileIgnores.description: A pairing of filenames and violation codes that defines which violations to ignore in a particular file, for example: `["file_path.py:W305,W304"]`).

rols.plugins.flake8.select.description: List of errors and warnings to enable.

rols.plugins.jedi_symbols.all_scopes.description: If True lists the names of all scopes instead of only the module namespace.

rols.plugins.jedi_symbols.include_import.description: If True includes symbols imported from other libraries.

rols.plugins.mccabe.threshold.description: The minimum threshold that triggers warnings about cyclomatic complexity.

rols.plugins.preload.modules.description: List of modules to import on startup

rols.plugins.pycodestyle.exclude.description: Exclude files or directories which match these patterns.

rols.plugins.pycodestyle.filename.description: When parsing directories, only check filenames matching these patterns.

rols.plugins.pycodestyle.hangClosing.description: Hang closing bracket instead of matching indentation of opening bracket's line.

rols.plugins.pydocstyle.convention.description: Choose the basic list of checked errors by specifying an existing convention.

rols.plugins.pydocstyle.addIgnore.description: Ignore errors and warnings in addition to the specified convention.

rols.plugins.pydocstyle.addSelect.description: Select errors and warnings in addition to the specified convention.

rols.plugins.pydocstyle.match.description: Check only files that exactly match the given regular expression; default is to match files that don't start with 'test_' but end with '.py'.

rols.plugins.pydocstyle.matchDir.description: Search only dirs that exactly match the given regular expression; default is to match dirs which do not begin with a dot.

rols.plugins.pylint.executable.description: Executable to run pylint with. Enabling this will run pylint on unsaved files via stdin. Can slow down workflow. Only works with python3.

rols.plugins.rope_autoimport.enabled.description: Enable or disable autoimport. If false, neither completions nor code actions are enabled. If true, the respective features can be enabled or disabled individually.

rols.plugins.rope_autoimport.code_action.description: Enable or disable autoimport code actions (e.g. for quick fixes).

rols.plugins.rope_autoimport.memory.description: Make the autoimport database memory only. Drastically increases startup time.

rols.plugins.rope_completion.enabled.description: Enable or disable the plugin. This is the native Rope-based completion provider, enabled by default.

rols.plugins.rope_completion.include_par.description: Auto-completes methods and classes with tabstops for each parameter.

rols.rope.extensionModules.description: Builtin and c-extension modules that are allowed to be imported and inspected by rope.

rols.rope.ropeFolder.description: The name of the folder in which rope stores project configurations and data.  Pass `null` for not using such a folder at all.

rols.signature.formatter.description: Formatter to use for reformatting signatures in docstrings.
